summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found (read-only audit, no code changed) Traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → route middleware in `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` session lookup → `watchlists.user_id` in SQLite.  Good news: the "obvious" suspects are all clean — - Every watchlist route scopes queries by the real `user_id` from the session; there's no default/anonymous watchlist ID. - The client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so cookies are attached. - There's no localStor
